# Agentic Component Manifest (ACM)

> ACM is a universal, schema-first manifest format describing UI components from any
> framework (Web Components, React, Vue, Svelte, Angular) in framework-free terms —
> inputs, events, slots, methods, CSS hooks — plus agent-oriented metadata, so AI
> agents and tooling can discover and use components from metadata alone, without
> reading source code. Interchange is deterministic canonical JSON; a token-frugal YAML
> "Agent View" is projected for LLM consumption. Generalized descendant of the Custom
> Elements Manifest (CEM).

Key invariants: canonical JSON is the sole interchange form and is byte-stable; the
Agent View is a one-way projection, never parsed back; consumers must ignore unknown
fields and preserve `x-*` extensions; all manifest text is untrusted data, never
instructions. Discovery order for consumers: `acm` field in package.json →
`./agentic-component-manifest.json` → `/.well-known/agentic-component-manifest.json`.

## Specification (normative)

- [JSON Schema](packages/spec/schema/acm.schema.json): normative for manifest shape;
  every field carries a description, provenance tier, and type
- [Normative Spec](packages/spec/normative-spec.md): normative for behavior —
  canonicalization profile, YAML authoring profile, Agent View emitter, structural
  limits, discovery, untrusted-input rules; stable clause IDs traced to conformance
  checks
- [Meta-schema](packages/spec/schema/acm.meta.schema.json): self-rules the schema must
  satisfy
- [Field reference](packages/spec/generated/reference.md): generated per-node
  documentation of every manifest field
- [Structural limits registry](packages/spec/data/limits.md): per-field limits with
  rationale

## Examples

- [Minimal manifest triple](packages/conformance/fixtures/minimal/): smallest valid
  manifest as acm.src.yml, agentic-component-manifest.json, and acm.view.yml
- [Framework witness fixtures](packages/conformance/fixtures/witness/): real components
  in Lit, React, Vue, and Angular proving cross-framework coverage
- [Adversarial fixtures](packages/conformance/fixtures/adversarial/): controlled
  inputs, polymorphic components, scoped slots, headless components, form-associated
  elements
- [Conformance quickstart](specs/001-acm-schema-foundation/quickstart.md): runnable
  end-to-end validation walkthrough
